Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Roll Guile to pull an enemy toward you. On Standard or Strong, you can also move 1 square without provoking.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One visible enemy within 4 squares.
Type
Magic / Control / Movement

Make a Guile control attack.

Weak
Pull the target 1 square toward you.
Standard
Pull it 1 square toward you; you may move 1 square without provoking.
Strong
Pull it 2 squares toward you; you may move 1 square without provoking.
